name: Incident Response Agent Evaluation
description: Validates that the incident agent properly delegates to sub-agents and produces a coherent incident summary

parts.text: We are seeing 503 errors from nginx-demo in default namespace after the last deploy. Investigate.

INCIDENT SUMMARY
================
Affected: nginx-demo in default
Duration: 14:30 to 14:45 UTC
Severity: P2
Root Cause: Bad image tag in latest deployment caused ImagePullBackOff

TIMELINE:
- 14:30: Deployment updated with image nginx:bad-tag
- 14:31: Pods enter ImagePullBackOff
- 14:32: Service endpoints depopulated, 503s begin
- 14:40: Rollback initiated
- 14:42: Previous version restored, pods healthy
- 14:45: Service endpoints repopulated, 503s resolved

ACTIONS TAKEN:
- Health check confirmed 0/3 pods ready with ImagePullBackOff
- Rollout history showed bad image tag in revision 3
- Rolled back to revision 2
- Verified 3/3 pods ready after rollback

STATUS: Resolved

args.message: Check health of nginx-demo deployment in default namespace
Show rollout history for nginx-demo in default namespace
Rollback nginx-demo in default namespace to previous revision
Verify nginx-demo in default is healthy after rollback

response.result: RESOURCE: nginx-demo in default | STATUS: Unhealthy | PODS: 0/3 ready | ImagePullBackOff on all pods
Revision 3 (current): nginx:bad-tag | Revision 2: nginx:1.25 | Revision 1: nginx:1.24
Rolled back to revision 2. Rollout status: successfully rolled out.
RESOURCE: nginx-demo in default | STATUS: Healthy | PODS: 3/3 ready | No issues

parts.text: Something is wrong with our app, pods keep restarting in the demo namespace

INCIDENT SUMMARY
================
Affected: app in demo
Severity: P3
Root Cause: OOMKilled — container memory limit too low

ACTIONS TAKEN:
- Delegated health check to specialist agent
- Identified CrashLoopBackOff with OOMKilled reason

RECOMMENDATION: Increase memory limits from 128Mi to 256Mi

STATUS: Investigating

args.message: Check health of all deployments in demo namespace, pods are restarting

response.result: RESOURCE: app in demo | STATUS: Unhealthy | PODS: 1/3 ready | CrashLoopBackOff: OOMKilled, memory limit 128Mi exceeded
